selection_basis.note: The bridge is the smallest rectangular closure joining the frozen r=0 selected core family to the already frozen positive target box while retaining exactly the target a2 and epsilon intervals. It was frozen before any P2 outward-rounded continuation result was run.

coverage_requirement: A P2 selected-continuation certificate must form a gap-free connected parameter cover from the complete r=0 anchor face through the complete frozen positive target box; isolated roots found only on r>=1/25 do not discharge this requirement.
mutation_policy: Never shrink or overwrite this bridge after inspecting a P2 rigorous result. A redesign requires a new versioned bridge that retains this record and explains the mathematical change.
nonclaims: Freezing the bridge does not prove that a homoclinic branch crosses it.
The zero-r face is a desingularized central-system anchor, not a positive PDE parameter value.
The phase-1 certificate on the positive target box is not an interval certificate on this larger bridge.
No temporal-stability, Turing-selection, or canard conclusion follows from this bridge.
